name: copy-button
title: Copy button
description: Copies a value to the clipboard; the icon turns into a check and a status says it was copied.

when: A value people paste elsewhere: an ID, an API key, a link, a command.

instead.when: The value is a field of a record, which DescriptionList can copy on its own.

guidance.rule: Icon-only, name what is copied: "Copy the invoice number".

builtIn: Says "Copied" (or that it could not copy) in a polite status, again on every press.
The check shows for two seconds.
youProvide: An aria-label naming the value when it is icon-only.
